items.title: Young Snooky — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Mel took the business and everything, but the leader was Thad. That‘s the same thing in this band. The leader is John Clayton. Jeff Hamilton, they do business and Jeff… but the leader is John Clayton. Now, I hope that isn‘t saying the wrong thing about the men, you know what I‘m saying.
No, but it clarifies the roles that each person is playing as a leader.
